commentary.executiveSummary: MacWest achieved a monumental 120.2% YoY revenue growth in Q1 2026 (GH¢ 12.72M) compared to Q1 2025. This follows a strong FY 2025 performance which closed with GH¢ 1.89M in net profit. The onboarding of Ada 1, 2 & 3; Anlo 1 & 2; MDF; the Bakanta Road Project; and other related projects is expected to stabilise operations and reduce overdependence on ENI. Despite reporting negative ROE and net margin, the company is expected to meet its profitability targets as projects are completed on schedule and new ones are onboarded.
commentary.pnlAnalysis: 2024 and 2025 comparatives show a significant expansion in revenue capacity. Gross margins improved to 37.7% in Q1 2026, up from historical lows in 2024. Despite reporting negative ROE and net margin, the company is expected to meet its profitability targets as projects are completed on schedule and new ones are onboarded.
commentary.balanceSheetAnalysis: The balance sheet remains strong with GH¢ 7.6M in equity. Cash reserves stand at GH¢ 5.76M, providing the necessary working capital to support the current growth trajectory. The onboarding of Ada 1, 2 & 3; Anlo 1 & 2; MDF; the Bakanta Road Project; and other related projects is expected to stabilise operations and reduce overdependence on ENI.

risks.description: The onboarding of Ada 1, 2 & 3; Anlo 1 & 2; MDF; the Bakanta Road Project; and other related projects is expected to stabilise operations and reduce overdependence on ENI.
The gap between Q1 actuals and the GH¢ 137M annual revenue budget is substantial. Profitability targets are expected to be met as projects are completed on schedule.
Current cash reserves are healthy but need to be protected during the period of project ramp-up.
